findings.title: Preserve support for v1 protobuf messages in the codec
findings.suggested_fix: Accept both protoadapt.MessageV1 and protoadapt.MessageV2 in Marshal and Unmarshal, converting v1 messages with protoadapt.MessageV2Of before passing them to the protobuf API; add a v1-only message round-trip test.
evidence: The diff changes the imported proto.Message from github.com/golang/protobuf/proto (v1 interface) to google.golang.org/protobuf/proto (v2 interface requiring ProtoReflect).

findings.title: Unwrap legacy status details before returning them
findings.suggested_fix: Append protoadapt.MessageV1Of(detail) to the result, and test a registered v1-only detail message through WithDetails and Details.
evidence: The previous ptypes.DynamicAny path calls ptypes.Empty, which converts the registered message via proto.MessageV1; protoadapt.MessageV1Of unwraps legacy v2 wrappers.

findings.title: Preserve support for legacy protobuf messages in the codec
findings.suggested_fix: Accept both protoadapt.MessageV1 and protoadapt.MessageV2 in Marshal and Unmarshal, converting v1 values with protoadapt.MessageV2Of before invoking the v2 codec; add a round-trip test using a v1-only message.
evidence: The diff replaces github.com/golang/protobuf/proto with google.golang.org/protobuf/proto; the former Message interface is the v1 interface while the latter requires ProtoReflect.

findings.title: Return concrete legacy status detail messages
findings.suggested_fix: Append protoadapt.MessageV1Of(detail) instead of detail, and test Details with a registered v1-only message and a concrete type assertion.

findings.title: Legacy protobuf RPC messages fail in the default codec
findings.suggested_fix: Accept both protoadapt.MessageV1 and protoadapt.MessageV2 in Marshal and Unmarshal, converting v1 messages with protoadapt.MessageV2Of; add a round-trip test with a v1-only generated message.
evidence: The diff switches proto.Message from github.com/golang/protobuf/proto to google.golang.org/protobuf/proto; the latter requires ProtoReflect while the former uses the original v1 interface.

findings.title: Legacy status details no longer match their generated type
findings.suggested_fix: Append protoadapt.MessageV1Of(detail) to the details slice and test a registered v1-only detail with a concrete-type assertion.
evidence: The former ptypes.DynamicAny decoding calls proto.MessageV1 on the newly allocated message; anypb.UnmarshalNew returns the v2 interface directly, whose legacy message reflection wrapper is not the original concrete Go type.

testing_gaps: Focused Go tests were started with the supplied offline caches using the installed Go binary; their results were not available before the review deadline.
